notes.title: 1.0.1 Changelog
notes.content:
Bug Fixes


 Fixed various stability issues during game initialization
 Resolved player list display inconsistencies
 Improved handling of disconnected players during matches
 Enhanced game state synchronization between players
 Fixed a number of smaller issues


Technical Improvements


 Connection Stability: Improved network reconnection handling and reduced connection drops
 Authentication: Made the startup sequence more reliable with better error handling


Game Balance Updates


 Card Drop Rates: Adjusted rare card drop chances to better balance the game economy and make matches more enjoyable
 Soul Drain Card: Fixed stability issues and improved reliability during matches


Quality of Life


 Matchmaking: Improved handling of game search timers and lobby states

notes.title: Duel Legends is out now!
notes.content:
Duel Legends is out now!
Hello everyone,

The wait is over - Duel Legends is officially live on Steam! You can now jump in and battle your way through the arenas.

We want to thank all of you who wishlisted, followed, and supported us during development. Your feedback has been invaluable, and today we are proud to open the gates for everyone.


What’s next

This is just the beginning. We’ll continue to refine the game, add new content, and keep listening to your ideas. Please share your thoughts in the Community Hub and let us know what you would like to see in future updates.

See you in the arena,
The Duel Legends Team

notes.title: Playtest Install Fix
notes.content:
Fixed an error that caused the game folder to be empty.
All game files are now properly packaged and displayed in the game folder.
Thank you for your patience and support. Enjoy playing the updated Duel Legends!
Special thanks to Cthu1huX, [RUS]FRAGnat and  Рэйнтру for reporting the issue!

notes.title: Upcoming Playtest!
notes.content:
Hello Duel Legends Community!

We're excited to announce that our playtest will launch on 29th March at 12:00 (GMT+2)! 
Join us for a one-week playtest as we work together to catch bugs, test server stability and make game more fun before the official launch!

Playtest Details:

Launch Date & Time: 29th March, 12:00 (GMT+2)

Other Time Zones:

 America/New York: 06:00
 Europe/London: 11:00
 Europe/Berlin: 12:00
 Asia/Tokyo: 20:00


Duration: Servers will be online for 1 week.

How will it help us?


 Help us catch as many bugs as possible.
 Test our servers under real conditions.
 All playtesters will receive exclusive gifts at the launch of the game for participating!
 We'll also be conducting a feedback survey afterwards to ensure we make Duel Legends even better and more fun.

Mark your calendars and get ready to duel! We can't wait to see you on the battlefield and hear your feedback.

Stay tuned for more updates!

— The Duel Legends Team
